abstract: To evaluate the long-term effects of abdominal irradiation for the treatment of seminoma of the testis on gastrointestinal function, 15 randomly selected patients who had been treated for stage I seminoma of the testis 2-10 years previously had the following parameters of gastrointestinal function evaluated: gastrointestinal symptoms; absorption of bile acid; vitamin B12; lactose and fat; gastric emptying; small intestinal and total gut transit; and intestinal permeability. Results were compared to those obtained in 18 normal volunteers. There was an increased prevalence of gastrointestinal symptoms (P < 0.01) in the patients and stool frequency was above the control range in two of them. Gastric emptying was faster (P < 0.01) in the patients. There were no significant differences in vitamin B12, bile acid, lactose or fat absorption, small intestinal transit or whole gut transit between the two groups, although faecal fat excretion was greater than the control range in three of the patients. At least one parameter of gastrointestinal function was abnormal in 11 of the 15 patients. Patients with right-sided seminoma had a greater bowel frequency when compared to those with left-sided seminoma (P < 0.05). We conclude that mild abnormalities in gastrointestinal function occur frequently when abdominal irradiation is used to treat stage I seminoma.
abstract_ja: 精巣の病期Iセミノーマの治療として腹部放射線照射を受けた、2〜10年前の患者から無作為に選んだ15例について、消化管機能の長期的影響を評価した。評価項目は、消化管症状、胆汁酸吸収、ビタミンB12、乳糖・脂肪吸収、胃排出能、小腸および全消化管通過時間、腸管透過性である。結果は健常者18例と比較した。患者では消化管症状の有病率が有意に高く（P<0.01）、排便回数が2例で正常範囲を上回った。胃排出は患者で有意に速かった（P<0.01）。ビタミンB12、胆汁酸、乳糖、脂肪の吸収、小腸および全腸管通過時間には両群間で有意差はなかったが、3例では糞便中脂肪排泄が正常範囲を上回った。15例中11例で消化管機能の少なくとも1項目が異常であった。右側のセミノーマ患者は左側の患者と比べて排便回数が多かった（P<0.05）。病期Iセミノーマに対して腹部放射線照射を行うと、軽度の消化管機能異常が高頻度に生じると結論づけられる。
